name: Red air: fiber-optic FPV (G1, jam-immune)
description: FPV quad steered over a fiber-optic spool. No RF emissions; immune to jamming. Slower due to spool drag.

maxSpeedMps.condition: up to 60 km/h for the class (17 m/s)
maxSpeedMps.source: RFE/RL, Fiber-Optic Drones The New Must-Have In Ukraine War (2025-03-12), globalsecurity.org mirror, quoting Serhiy Beskrestnov

controlLinkRangeM.condition: 10000 m of fibre for the class
controlLinkRangeM.source: RFE/RL, Fiber-Optic Drones The New Must-Have In Ukraine War (2025-03-12), globalsecurity.org mirror, quoting Serhiy Beskrestnov

maxTurnRateDegS.note: Planning factor: the flight-path turn rate a multirotor can hold at its cruise speed is g tan(tilt) / V. No tilt cap is published; the PX4 MPC_TILTMAX_AIR default of 45° is used, and the reel mass holds the cruise speed down. At the record's cruise speed 15 m/s: 9.8 / 15 rad/s = 37°/s. The body yaw-rate cap (DJI publishes 100 to 300°/s; PX4 MC_YAWRATE_MAX 200°/s) is not a path turn limit and is not used.

climbRateMps.note: Planning factor: no vendor publishes a climb rate for a fibre-optic FPV (Skywalker gives a 190 km/h top speed and a 3 kg payload with the 10 km reel). A 10-inch build with the reel keeps thrust-to-weight near 2; 10 m/s is taken as the sustained climb.

maxAccelMps2.note: Planning factor: a multirotor's horizontal acceleration is g tan(tilt). No tilt cap is published; the PX4 MPC_TILTMAX_AIR default of 45° is used. 9.81 × tan 45° = 9.8 m/s².

radiatedPowerW.condition: no RF link: control and video run over the fibre-optic tether (Skywalker Technology fibre FPV)
radiatedPowerW.source: Militarnyi, Chinese drone maker introduces UAV controlled by fiber optics

attributes.rangeNote: Fielded fiber spools of 10, 15, and 20 km confirmed in combat; 41-50 km spools demonstrated on larger frames.

threatProfile.routeIntent: Terrain-hugging attack on rear-area targets, 5-20 km out

linkProtocol.source: Militarnyi (Skywalker fibre-optic FPV) and Wikipedia, Fiber optic drone
